models.name: Meshy (latest)
models.notes: The node always uses the 'latest' placeholder, which the Meshy API resolves to the current newest model (no explicit model list). Covers 7 nodes: Text to Model / Image to Model / Multi-Image to Model / Refine Draft / Rig / Animate / Texture. Integrated 2026-01-14. [verified: resolves to Meshy-6, GA 2026-01-18; no Meshy-7, sources: meshy.ai/blog/meshy-6-launch]

notes: Meshy is a mature 3D asset generation service that produces usable low-poly characters from text/images, with auto-rigging and an animation motion library. A single 'latest' model selection - no need to worry about versions.

models.name: v3.1-20260211
models.notes: Latest version (Tripo v3.1) and the default model version, with the best quality. [verified: official changelog 1.9.5 release 2026-03-11 (date-code 20260211), still latest, sources: docs.tripo3d.ai]

models.name: v3.0-20250812
models.notes: Tripo v3.0 - mature and stable, still a reasonable choice. [verified: official launch 2025-09-26 (changelog 1.9.1), superseded by v3.1, sources: docs.tripo3d.ai]

models.name: v2.5-20250123
models.notes: Older version, superseded by v3.x; use only when reproducing old results.

models.name: v2.0-20240919
models.notes: Outdated version, not recommended for new tasks.

models.name: v1.4-20240625
models.notes: Oldest version; the Tripo: Refine Draft model node only supports draft models generated by v1.4 - kept for compatibility.

models.name: Tripo P1
models.notes: Dedicated P1 node (P1 Text/Image/Multiview to Model), optimized for low-poly, game-engine-ready meshes with stable topology. Integrated 2025-05-27. [verified: P1-20260311 Smart Mesh, ~2s generation, sources: developers.tripo3d.ai]

notes: Tripo was the first 3D partner integrated (2025-05-27) and has the most complete node set: generation (text/image/multi-view), texturing, refinement, rigging, retargeting, format conversion, and external model import. The model_version input explicitly lists all 5 versions; there is also a TripoP1 node series. Defaults to v2.5; manual selection of v3.1 is recommended.

models.name: Rodin Gen-1 (Regular/Detail/Smooth/Sketch)
models.notes: Four generation-tier nodes from the legacy API (Regular/Detail/Smooth/Sketch), differentiated by quality/mode, image input only. Superseded by Gen-2/Gen-2.5. Integrated 2025-05-27. [verified: Gen-2.5 is latest family, no Gen-3, sources: docs.hyper3d.ai]

models.name: Rodin Gen-2
models.notes: Second-generation generation model, single node (Gen-2 Generate); quality and detail surpass the Gen-1 tiers. [verified: Gen-2.5 is latest family, no Gen-3, sources: docs.hyper3d.ai]

models.name: Rodin Gen-2.5
models.notes: Newest generation, split into Image to 3D (supports 1-5 reference images) and Text to 3D nodes; outputs any 3D format (GLB/OBJ/FBX/STL/GLTF). [verified: Gen-2.5 is latest family, no Gen-3, sources: docs.hyper3d.ai]

notes: Rodin (Hyper3D) was initially integrated as four quality-tier nodes, later upgraded to Gen-2 / Gen-2.5. Nodes have no explicit model dropdown; the model is distinguished by the node itself. Prefer Gen-2.5 for new tasks.

models.notes: Latest API version; note the LowPoly option is unavailable under 3.1. Integrated 2026-01-25.
Earlier version, supports LowPoly mode; usable in parallel with 3.1.

notes: Tencent Hunyuan 3D suite: two generation nodes (Text/Image(s) to Model) with model selection (3.0/3.1), plus post-processing nodes such as Model to UV, 3D Texture Edit, 3D Part (part recognition/generation), and Smart Topology (retopology).

models.name: eleven_v3
models.notes: Latest TTS model, used by the Text to Speech and Text to Dialogue nodes; supports speed/similarity_boost parameters. Integrated 2026-02-20.

models.name: eleven_multilingual_v2
models.notes: Multilingual TTS v2, still a solid choice; supports speed/similarity_boost/use_speaker_boost/style parameters.

models.name: scribe_v2
models.notes: STT transcription model with automatic language detection, diarize speaker separation, audio event labeling (laughter/music, etc.), and timestamp granularity control.

models.name: eleven_sfx_v2
models.notes: Text-to-Sound-Effects model (Text to Sound Effects); supports duration, loop, and prompt-following parameters.

models.name: eleven_multilingual_sts_v2
models.notes: Multilingual Speech-to-Speech; preserves the original content and emotion while converting to a target voice.

models.name: eleven_english_sts_v2
models.notes: English-only Speech-to-Speech model.

models.name: Instant Voice Clone
models.notes: No explicit model name; clones a voice instantly from an audio sample for reuse by the TTS/STS nodes (paired with Voice Selector).

notes: ElevenLabs covers the full pipeline - TTS, STT, STS, sound effect generation, voice cloning, and voice isolation (denoising); models are explicitly listed in the DynamicCombo. Integrated 2026-02-20.

notes: Anthropic is a single node (ClaudeNode) supporting multimodal input of up to 20 images, thinking modes (adaptive/budgeted/forced), and temperature plus reasoning effort control. CLAUDE_MODELS lists 9 models, from Opus 4.6 to Opus 5. Integrated 2026-05-13.

models.name: Seed 2.0 Pro
models.notes: Flagship model; model ID includes the date (seed-2-0-pro-260328). Integrated 2026-05-18.

models.name: Seed 2.0 Lite
models.notes: Lightweight version (seed-2-0-lite-260228); better speed and cost.

models.name: Seed 2.0 Mini
models.notes: Mini version (seed-2-0-mini-260215); weakest capabilities, only suited to simple tasks - Pro/Lite already cover its use cases.

notes: The ByteDance Seed 2.0 series is integrated via the BytePlus ModelArk Responses API as a single node (ByteDanceSeedNode), supporting multimodal input of up to 20 images + 4 video clips. Integrated 2026-05-18.

models.name: SwitchX
models.notes: SwitchX is Beeble's editing model (no explicit model dropdown). Video Edit supports replacing any scene element (background/lighting/clothing, etc.) while keeping subject pixels and motion intact (up to 240 frames); Image Edit is the image counterpart of the same capability. Integrated 2026-05-27.

notes: Beeble is positioned as a video/image editing partner (not generative): it replaces scene elements using a reference image plus a text prompt, with alpha matte output.

models.name: HeyGen Avatar IV
models.notes: Latest digital human engine; the Talking Photo node uses it for lip-synced animation of any portrait photo, and the Avatar Video node also prefers avatars that support Avatar IV. Integrated 2026-07-17.

models.name: HeyGen Avatar III
models.notes: Previous digital human engine, still used by only a few legacy avatars; prefer Avatar IV for new tasks.

models.name: HeyGen Starfish
models.notes: HeyGen TTS engine (Text to Speech node); supports SSML, speed adjustment, and custom voice IDs; voices must be compatible with the Starfish engine.

models.name: Video Translate
models.notes: Video Translate node: translates spoken videos into other languages, clones the original speaker's voice, and maintains lip sync.

notes: HeyGen covers the full digital human video pipeline: Talking Photo (photo talking), Avatar Video (avatar broadcasting), Create Avatar (custom avatars), Video Translate (translation + voice cloning), and Starfish TTS. Nodes have no model dropdown; the engine is reflected in the DynamicCombo/descriptions. Integrated 2026-07-17.
